sections.thesis: Pending home sales in the US fell to a record low in September as mortgage rates surged.

sentences.text: Pending home sales in the US fell to a record low in September as mortgage rates surged.
The index dropped 7.3% from August against a forecast fall of 0.5%, and housing starts fell more than expected to 1.22mn.
Mortgage rates are at three-year highs as Treasury yields rise on expectations the Federal Reserve will need to raise rates to control inflation.

sections.thesis: The dollar stayed under pressure after slipping to a three-week low, as lower Treasury yields and crude prices reduced its appeal.

sentences.text: The dollar stayed under pressure after slipping to a three-week low, as lower Treasury yields and crude prices reduced its appeal.
The Australian dollar rose to $0.7013 after RBA Deputy Governor Andrew Hauser said the inflation outlook looked "materially worse".
Traders remain wary of the euro, steady at $1.1229, as France faces protests and a worsening fiscal picture.

sections.thesis: US stocks rebounded after a report that mediators had proposed reviving US-Iran talks, with the Dow up 1% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%.

sentences.text: US stocks rebounded after a report that mediators had proposed reviving US-Iran talks, with the Dow up 1% and the S&P 500 up 0.3%.
A South Korean data-centre company sank 32% on its debut, sending the Kospi down 3.7%.
Netflix shares fell more than 5% after hours on its slowest revenue growth in three years and a downbeat outlook.

sections.thesis: Oil tumbled on reports of a Qatar-Pakistan compromise proposal, then bounced when Iran said reports a deal was close were wrong.

sentences.text: Oil tumbled on reports of a Qatar-Pakistan compromise proposal, then bounced when Iran said reports a deal was close were wrong.
Brent futures fell 0.7% to $108.79 a barrel and US crude 1.8% to $101.79.
Middle East oil flows averaged more than 24 million barrels a day in the week to 18 October, above prewar levels of 23.3 million.
